jobs.description:
Position Summary

On-site, Facility-based position that coordinates transition of client care between inpatient setting and outpatient setting. Including: Sober Living, Intensive Outpatient Programs, Therapists, Psychiatrists, and/or other providers as clinically indicated. Meets with clients on a regular basis to assess aftercare needs and works closely with treatment team and clinical outreach to provide appropriate referrals. This is maintained through coordination with client's assigned therapist, assigned admissions coordinator, clinical outreach or other appropriate staff to ensure quality and appropriate care. This is conducted through weekly face-to-face 30-minute sessions with clients throughout their residential stay. More meetings may be required for longer stays or extenuating circumstances with client.

Essential Job Functions

Demonstrates the ability to develop a thorough continuing care plan that is in alignment with treatment team recommendations, business development and client's individual needs
Communicates with outside therapists and other appropriate parties as indicated within the compliance of HIPPA requirements
Addresses discharge planning needs and concerns from clients.
Initiates Client Discharge Plan within 24 hours of admission, completes and reviews with the client prior to discharge
Responsible for the Coordination of care within 72 hours of admission and Family Contact within 48 hours of admission and documenting both in client's chart.
Facilitate 1-2 aftercare groups as needed per week.
Meets weekly or as needed with client
Completes Discharge Planning Progress Notes for each client
Documents outbound referrals in the client's chart and salesforce
Maintain knowledge of client discharge date through assigned therapist and admissions team (as dates may change in accordance with insurance)
Must meet with clients a minimum of 3 sessions
Maintain timely scheduled initial sessions with clients within 6 days of intake.
Must meet with client 1 week before discharge to secure Discharge Referrals and suggest possible extension if client's aftercare plan is not a suitable structure for success.
Must meet with clients 1 week before discharge to secure appointments for clients with outside providers. (Psychiatrist and Therapist appointments for clients before discharge, securing bed in Sober Living, etc.)
Thorough research of recommended Outpatient services Sober Livings, therapists, psychiatrists) to ensure quality referrals. Research conducted will include primarily clinical outreach recommended referrals, internet screening for well-trusted services, phone calls to verify appropriateness and reserving available space if transitioning to a sober living.
Building effective and lasting relationships with referents and community providers

Required: Minimum of 3 years' experience in a mental health, chemical dependency setting or healthcare.
Required: Experience working with clients and documentation in a hospital and/or mental health facility
Preferred:
A bachelor's degree in psychology, Social Work or other related field
CADC (Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor) Certificate.

SUNACT Cancer Institute is a specialized cancer care center led by Dr. Vijay Patil, focused on delivering advanced, evidence-based treatments. Comfort working in an intensive clinical environment and willingness to participate in training, continuing education, and team meetings.

Under general supervision, supports the organization in implementation of initiatives related to obtaining and maintaining Magnet™ designation and ensuring the organization's milieu reflects the internalization of the five components of Magnet. Serves as the primary coordinator and resource person for obtaining and sustaining designation as an ANCC Magnet™ hospital. At Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services (CFMWS), we’re more than just a workplace; we’re a proud community dedicated to supporting Canadian Armed Forces members, veterans and their families in their daily lives. We carefully curate and provide programs and services designed to meet their unique needs and enhance their mental, social, physical, financial and familial well-being. You will have a chance to expand your skills and share your passions as you mentor junior staff and volunteers all with the goal of improving the quality of life for our military.
